set.body: Pass only when every admitted Tier-1 row has correct output, Grakern beats the fastest correct comparator by the declared practical and noise criterion, no material time, memory, capacity, or scaling loss remains unexplained, and raw receipts reproduce on an immutable source and quiescent host. Ties are not wins. A losing row remains open work. Confirmed comparator defects require a minimized fixture, permanent regression, source attribution, and an upstream-ready report.
set.title: Gate Performance: win the admitted exact-kernel race
